 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 19.1 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, India with a 10-wicket thrashing of Nepal. It's a flat length delivery and Aaryavir Sehwag comes down the track to knock it down to long-on. Handshakes follow 18.6 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, scores level. It's tossed up full on leg-stump, Aaryavir Sehwag comes down the track and makes room to drive to long-off 18.5 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short and wide outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and cuts straight to the fielder at backward point 18.4 4 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, FOUR , a half-volley on middle, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward and drills it hard and straight. Bipin Sharma can't stop it and no chance for long-off and long-on. Went past the bowler's feet in a flash, even before he could react 18.2 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, slower and good length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches to sweeper cover 18.1 4 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, FOUR , tossed up full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward and opens the face of the bat to loft over backward point. Sweeper runs and dives to his left to push it back, but can't. Four more 17.6 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to loft, doesn't time it, had he done so, would've either got six or holed out to long-on. Lands well short of the fielder 17.5 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, flat good length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches to extra-cover 17.4 4 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, byes, FOUR , Aashish Luhar is nutmegged and it runs away for four. Thrown up wide outside off, full, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive, misses, the ball keeps low and Luhar can't close his legs in time 17.3 4 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, FOUR , one bounce over the ropes straight down the ground. It's tossed up full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag sinks on his back knee and lofts beautifully. Got the elevation and the power behind it 17.2 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, tossed up full on off, a nice leaning forward defence to extra-cover 16.6 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, fired full on leg-stump, Aaryavir Sehwag backs away and loses his bottom-hand, drives straight to the fielder at extra-cover on the edge of the ring 16.5 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, quicker good length on middle, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to flick to mid-wicket 16.2 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, tossed up full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward and drives hard and straight to long-off 15.2 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive to sweeper cover 14.4 Abhay Yadav to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, full on middle, Aaryavir Sehwag is on the walk and looks for an ugly hoick across the line, the thick outside edge flies away to third man but lands well short 14.3 Abhay Yadav to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, fullish outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag is on the walk as he drives straight to the fielder to mid-off 14.2 Abhay Yadav to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short of length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches to cover 14.1 Abhay Yadav to Aaryavir Sehwag, SIX , 50 for Aaryavir Sehwag. He raises the bat. Gets a healthy round of applause from his mates. Full outside off, he is on the walk and shows the full face of the bat to loft it straight down the ground. Held the pose and relied on timing it and the ball soars straight down the ground 13.6 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, flat good length on off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches it to long-on 13.5 4 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, FOUR , too full and crashed wide of the fielder at long-off. Aaryavir Sehwag motoring along now. It's full and wide outside off, he gets forward and drives crisply, races away to the long-off fielder's left who tries in vain to stop 13.4 6 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, SIX , what a blow. It's full on off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward and lofts through the line. Mid-on is inside and this goes all the way over long-on. Calculated hit and it's off the middle of the bat 13.2 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, flat good length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches it to long-off 13.1 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, on a good length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches, backward point dives to his right to save runs 12.1 Abhay Yadav to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, length delivery outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive and the thick outside edge runs fine to third man 11.5 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive to long-off 11.4 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, tossed up full on middle, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive and cover gets across and cuts it off to his right 11.3 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, good length and goes straight on to off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot to defend it back 11.2 Sachin Bhatt to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, tossed up on a good length on off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to defend to cover 10.2 Abhay Yadav to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, on a good length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches, loses one hand on the bat-handle, but gets it wide of mid-off 10.1 6 Abhay Yadav to Aaryavir Sehwag, SIX , what a shot. Full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag is on the walk and holds the pose as he lofts over wide long-off. High elbow and great timing as it flies all the way. He held the pose for the cameramen as he loved the shot 9.6 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, tries the yorker but it's a low full-toss on middle, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive it hard and straight to long-off 9.5 4 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, FOUR , punched away square of the wicket on the off-side for four. Splits cover-point and backward point. It's a flat good length delivery outside off, keeps a tad low, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to punch it into the gap 9.4 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, wide of the crease and flat good length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to punch to cover-point 9.3 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, good length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive and inside-edges it back down the track 9.2 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, flat good length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches to cover 9.1 6 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, SIX , tossed up full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward and to the pitch of the ball, swipes it high and over long-on. The fielder was in the circle and Sehwag cleared him easily. Sliced it sort of but got enough bat on it 7.6 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, length delivery on middle, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive to mid-on 7.3 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, low full-toss on middle, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to flick to mid-on and they take a quick single 7.2 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, tossed up full on middle, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive to mid-on 6.6 Abhay Yadav to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short of length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches to mid-off 6.3 Abhay Yadav to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, short of length and sliding down leg-stump, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and tucks to deep backward square-leg 5.6 Bipin Sharma to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, wide of the crease and fires the yorker on middle, dug out 4.6 Sushil Rawal to Aaryavir Sehwag, 2 runs, back of a length on middle, Aaryavir Sehwag is on the move again as he nicely tucks it wide of deep square leg for two 4.5 4 Sushil Rawal to Aaryavir Sehwag, FOUR , short of length outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag is on the walk again, punches with a high-elbow. Open-face and it's wide of cover and runs away for the 2nd four of the over 4.4 Sushil Rawal to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, pitched up outside off, angling away from the right-hander, left alone 4.3 4 Sushil Rawal to Aaryavir Sehwag, FOUR , lovely cover-drive. Full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag is already batting outside his crease, he gets way forward as he is on the walk, drives it wide of cover and mid-off. Took it on the half-volley and put it away 4.2 Sushil Rawal to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, good length and tight on off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and defends square to backward point 4.1 Sushil Rawal to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, length delivery outside off, angling away from the right-hander, left alone 2.6 Sushil Rawal to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, length delivery outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag walks towards the ball and leaves it 1.6 Nitesh Patel to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short of length and nips back in to off, Aaryavir Sehwag walks down the track, defends it back 1.1 Nitesh Patel to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, full outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag gets forward to drive and the ball nips back in a long way, the thick inside edge goes to deep backward square-leg LATEST NEWS
